subject: Escalation: One-time term approval for OrionCare - tiered credit & pricing structure
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Escalation: One-time term approval for OrionCare - tiered credit & pricing structure

Team —

Quick context: OrionCare (mid-stage digital chronic care provider) is requesting a one-time commercial exception to close a 3-year committed deal. Key points below:
- ACV ask: $1.2M ARR equivalent over 3 years (annualized value in year 1 ~ $480k)
- Request: 40% first-year discount off list for the core inference + embeddings bundle + additional 10k free embedding credits for onboarding
- Payment terms: 60 days net / quarterly invoicing preferred by procurement
- Competitive pressure: Vendor X has offered a 30% discount + integration credits; customer is leaning to accelerate decision this week

Why escalate: this exceeds standard discount bands and includes an odd payment cadence + extra onboarding credits. Customer is asking for VP/CFO sign-off before they move legal to redlines.

Attachments: proposed term sheet (OrionCare_Proposed_Term_Sheet_v3.pdf) and procurement thread from their side.

Asks:
1) Marcus/Ben — can you confirm the committed throughput profile (tokens/day) and whether the 10k embedding credit can be staged (50% upfront, 50% after GA)?
2) Markus — request your high-level signoff for an exception or a counter (I suggest a 25% first-year tiered discount + SLO credit pool instead of flat 40%). We need a definitive path to respond by COB tomorrow (10/31).
3) Monica — legal review on the requested payment term and whether we can require an early payment incentive instead of 60N.

I intentionally looped in finance and legal for speed. I will set a 30-minute sync if useful.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Escalation: One-time term approval for OrionCare - tiered credit & pricing structure

Hannah —

Thanks for the heads up. A few quick data points from my side:
- Forecasted token profile (per their technical contact): 4.2M generation tokens/month + 1.1M embedding tokens/month in year 1 (spikes expected during onboarding month 1).
- They want the embedding credits to be purely additive and non-refundable.
- Deal timeline: procurement needs a signed commercial term before they release to legal; they're trying to sign by 11/05.

On the commercial ask: 40% + 10k embedding credits feels high given expected unit economics. I'm aligned with proposing a staged credit and performance-based SLO credits.

If Marcus/Markus are comfortable, I can push a counter: 25% t1 discount + 5k onboarding credits + target-based SLO credits (credits applied as % of next invoice for missed latency/availability SLOs). Also push for Net30 with 2% 10-day early pay.

I'll be on the call with the customer tomorrow at 9am PT if you want me to float the counter live.

—Ben

Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Appreciate the full context. High level: I'm supportive of a commercial exception to land this strategic vertical account provided we protect unit economics and lock multi-year commitment and renewal pricing floor.

Proposed for CFO signoff:
- Commercial outline: 3-year committed term, annual billing.
- Pricing: 25% off list for year 1, 10% off list for year 2, 5% off list for year 3 (volume floors apply).
- Embedding credits: 5k free credits staged — 2.5k at signing, 2.5k after onboarding milestone (completion of integration test).
- SLO credits: 2% invoice credit bucket if monthly P95 latency > threshold or availability < 99.9%.
- Payment terms: Net30 preferred; propose 2% discount for 10-day early pay to replace 60N ask.

If Markus signs off here, I'll have Ben present the counter on the call tomorrow.

-Marcus

Team —

Thanks for the clear framing. A few finance points and required conditions before I can sign an exception:
1) Margin impact: run P&L on the proposed 25%/10%/5% structure across expected token mix and include embedding-credit redemption assumptions. I need projected gross margin by year and a 3-year blended margin. (Monica, please confirm contract language to cap credit redemption scheduling).
2) Payment terms: I cannot approve Net60 as default. Acceptable compromise is Net30 with 2%/10 early pay incentive OR Net45 with a modest finance fee (1.5%).
3) Revenue recognition: we need clarity on when we count committed revenue vs consumed credits; accounting will not accept deferred recognition for non-billable credits beyond the onboarding milestone.
4) Executive credit authority: any incremental one-time onboarding credits >5k need CFO sign-off in writing.

If the above are addressed, I will approve a 25% first-year discount conditional on legal inserting an overage clause (list pricing applies once usage exceeds committed floors).

Please circulate the pricing_calcs_Q3Q4.xlsx with the margin sheet by EOD today so I can sign.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Chief Financial Officer | Redwood Inference

Markus / team —

Thanks — appreciate the clear finance guardrails. Per Markus's request I've attached the margin workbook (pricing_calcs_Q3Q4.xlsx) with conservative redemption scenarios and three blended margin cases. Key changes we will present to the customer tomorrow:
- Counter commercial: 25% Y1 / 10% Y2 / 5% Y3 (volume floors apply).
- Embedding credits: 5k total, staged 2.5k at signing + 2.5k after onboarding milestone. Any additional onboarding credits require explicit CFO signoff.
- Payment terms: counter with Net30 + 2% 10-day early pay incentive. If procurement refuses, propose Net45 + 1.5% finance fee as fallback.
- SLO credits: established as invoice credit bucket tied to defined metrics (we have a short SLO appendix in the term sheet).

Monica — please confirm legal language for the onboarding milestone and overage clause so we can present a redline-ready term sheet. Ben — you and I will present the counter on the 11/03 customer call at 9am PT.

If Markus can confirm high-level signoff on the conditional 25% structure (assuming the attached margin calc), I will mark this as approved for external presentation.

Thanks,
Hannah
